citations.title: Corporate Profile

sentences.text: Hiromichi Matsuda is President, Representative Director and CEO of KDDI Corporation, the Tokyo-listed Japanese telecommunications group (securities code 9433, TSE Prime Market), a role he has held since April 1, 2025.

President, Representative Director, CEO
Hiromichi Matsuda
sentences.text: KDDI's corporate profile lists him as President, Representative Director, CEO.
He was promoted from Managing Executive Officer, taking over from Makoto Takahashi, who became chairman.
Before the appointment he served as Managing Executive Officer and Director, acting as CDO and executive director of the Advancing Business Technology Sector.
He is named as representative in KDDI's regulatory disclosures and was renominated as President and Representative Director in the slate put to the June 2026 shareholders meeting.

citations.title: KDDI Announces Leadership Changes Effective June 17, 2026

sentences.quote: Furthermore, two new independent director candidates, Kazuhiko Masuda and Kenichi Ogasawara, will join the board. Independent director candidate Kenichi Ogasawara will also serve as an audit committee member.
sentences.text: KDDI announced on March 31, 2026 a change of representative director effective June 17, 2026, under which Yasuaki Kuwahara steps down as representative director while board chairman Makoto Takahashi takes on the role, alongside three new director candidates and two new audit and supervisory board candidates.

sentences.quote: Hiroshi Fusei will oversee Business Core and Business Growth divisions, while Masami Sasaki will lead Personal Sector operations. Meanwhile, four directors-Hiroshi Takezawa, Gorou Wataru, Keiji Yamamoto, and Junko Okawa-are set to retire.
sentences.text: The same package assigned Hiroshi Fusei to the Business Core and Business Growth divisions and Masami Sasaki to Personal Sector operations, with directors Hiroshi Takezawa, Gorou Wataru, Keiji Yamamoto and Junko Okawa retiring, and independent candidates Kazuhiko Masuda and Kenichi Ogasawara joining.
On October 1, 2026 KDDI named Kohtaro Murasawa president and CEO of KDDI America and Telehouse America, succeeding Satoshi Oishi, who returns to Japan for a new leadership role.
